# ledger_occurrences (Data Source)

These are derived reports, not configuration. The occurrences of commitments in one month with their payment state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The occurrences of one month. "status" is what Ledger shows; "derived_status" ignores a person's override.
data "ledger_occurrences" "march" {
  month = "2026-03"
}

output "overdue" {
  value = [for o in data.ledger_occurrences.march.items : "${o.amount.amount} ${o.amount.currency}" if o.payment.status == "overdue"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `month` (String) The month, YYYY-MM.

### Optional

- `category_id` (String) Only occurrences in this category.
- `commitment_id` (String) Only occurrences of this commitment.
- `include_cancelled` (Boolean) Include cancelled occurrences.
- `label_id` (String) Only occurrences with this label.
- `max_items` (Number) The most items to read (1 to 10000); 1000 when unset.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API had more items than max_items; narrow the filters or raise max_items.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Attributes) The amount due. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--amount))
- `cancelled_at` (String) When it was cancelled, or null.
- `cancelled_reason` (String) out_of_range, terms_change or commitment_deleted, or null.
- `commitment_id` (String) The commitment it belongs to.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `due_date` (String) The due date, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `id` (String) The occurrence identifier. Ledger derives occurrences from commitments and may recreate them.
- `month` (String) The month it falls in, YYYY-MM.
- `payment` (Attributes) The payment state. status is what Ledger shows: it is derived_status from the evidence unless the person set an override; the override and its reason are kept separately so the two are never confused. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--payment))
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version.

<a id="nestedatt--items--amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Exact decimal amount as a string, in the scale Ledger stores it. Never a floating-point number.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code of amount.


<a id="nestedatt--items--payment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.payment`

Read-Only:

- `bank_evidence_count` (Number) Of those, the ones matched to a bank transaction.
- `derived_status` (String) The status derived from recorded evidence alone, ignoring any override.
- `evidence_count` (Number) Payments counted as evidence, bank and manual.
- `grace_until` (String) The end of the creditor's grace period, or null.
- `leeway` (String) not_recorded, unknown, none, period or deadline, or null.
- `manual_evidence_count` (Number) Of those, the ones the person recorded by hand.
- `outstanding_amount` (Attributes) What is still owed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--payment--outstanding_amount))
- `overpaid_amount` (Attributes) What was paid beyond the amount due. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--payment--overpaid_amount))
- `override` (Attributes) The person's status override, or null when there is none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--payment--override))
- `paid_amount` (Attributes) The amount paid, in the currency of the occurrence. Evidence in another currency is not converted here: see unconverted_currencies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--payment--paid_amount))
- `shortfall_amount` (Attributes) What is missing against a tolerance-accepted payment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--payment--shortfall_amount))
- `status` (String) paid, partially_paid, upcoming, due, overdue, not_recorded or cancelled.
- `timing` (String) upcoming, due, overdue or not_recorded, or null.
- `unconverted_currencies` (List of String) Currencies of payment evidence that could not be counted because no conversion applies.
- `within_grace` (Boolean) True while the occurrence is late but inside the grace period.

- `status` (String) paid or unpaid.
